entries.name: Akhil Rao (brother; injured Breaker mind-power, recovering)
entries.note: 26, Telugu, Shake's brother & peer; practical/cynical/analytical. Breaker (PL 9) MIND power (telepathy/influence/fear) — costly (nosebleeds, a psychic "ring"), tech-leashed, uncontrolled; currently injured/offline, recovering. Reads the Rush in Shake.

entries.name: Bhaskar Rao (Dad; vascular surgeon; manifested phasing)
entries.note: ~60s, vascular surgeon, inventive/scattered/entrepreneurial. Manifested phasing/intangibility (new, hiding it). Runs the aid-station with Sudha.

entries.name: Sudha Rao (Mom; surgeon; unchanged; family anchor)
entries.note: ~60s, retired general surgeon; grounded, the family anchor; unchanged. Took charge of Akhil's care.

entries.name: The Rao aid-station survivors (~2 dozen civilians)
entries.note: ~2 dozen civilians in the Newark refuge.

entries.name: Marian (ER nurse, ally; left behind at the Crossing)
entries.note: Veteran ER nurse, ally at the Crossing — left behind (N. NJ).

entries.name: Ana / strip-mall survivors (positive legend: 'the doctor who fell')
entries.note: Diabetic "Ana" & strip-mall survivors (N. NJ), stocked by Shake; hold a positive legend of "the doctor who fell from the sky."

entries.name: The Shepherd (Warlord mind-Dominator)
entries.note: WARLORD mind-Dominator (Thread 2). Campaign-scale; aware of the brothers.

entries.name: Sgt. Dana Vance (Crossing leader; hostile)
entries.note: Ex-Trenton PD; decent-hard leader of the Crossing exodus; betrayed by Shake's flight → hostile. Last redirected N to the Poconos.

entries.name: Boyd (Crossing hardliner; leads the hunt)
entries.note: Crossing hardliner/ex-CO; vindicated when the brothers' nature detonated; leads the hunt; rising rival to Vance. (Crossing notables: Hollis, pastor/moral voice; Tomas, quartermaster.)

entries.name: Dylan (NJ speedster; bitter; holds Mateo)
entries.note: ~16 speedster (NJ middle-school fief); saved his friend Sofia via Shake, then betrayed when Shake flew off — bitter; holds Mateo.

entries.name: Mateo (~6yo, abandoned at Dylan's school)
entries.note: ~6, rescued then left at Dylan's school (w/ teacher Hannah). Abandonment/Legacy.

entries.name: The Changed of the grove (Mateo's father; hunting)
entries.note: Heavy transformed predator, Mateo's father; alive, hunting.

entries.name: The train Telekinetic (Day-0 manifester; fate unknown)
entries.note: Day-0 manifester; fate unknown (may have died in his eruption).
